text:
Nina Park: Need quick copy review for a 'dry run' deploy confirmation. Product wants a low-friction modal so engineers know this is non-destructive. Current title: 'Run deployment dry run?'. Body: 'This will simulate the rollout without changing live traffic. Continue?'. CTA primary: 'Run dry run' secondary: 'Cancel'. Feels a bit terse.
Jordan Park: Prefer benefit-first and explicit consequence. Title: 'Simulate deployment (dry run)'. Body: 'We9ll run the deployment steps and report errors without switching traffic. No changes will be applied.' CTA: Primary 'Run simulation' Secondary 'Cancel'.
Samir Patel: Keep it scan-friendly. Also add an inline note about duration: 'Typically takes 2-5 minutes.' Might help set expectations.
Olga Kuznetsova: Accessibility: modal title should be clear, and focus should go to primary CTA. For screen readers, append a short accessible hint: 'This action does not modify production traffic.' Use aria-describedby for that extra sentence rather than packing it into the visible title.
Rohit Desai: Dev constraints: title limited to 60 chars, body to 200. We also need i18n keys and a boolean flag `is_non_destructive=true` for analytics. For small screens, CTA truncates so prefer 'Run simulation' over longer verbs.
Nina Park: Draft options:
- Friendly explicit: Title: 'Simulate deployment (dry run)' Body: 'Run the deployment steps and report any errors. No traffic will be changed. Typically takes a few minutes.' CTA: 'Run simulation' Secondary: 'Cancel'
- Minimal: Title: 'Dry run deployment' Body: 'Simulate rollout without changing traffic.' CTA: 'Run dry run' Secondary: 'Cancel'
Which should we default to? Also should we show an optional checkbox 'Also run smoke tests' in the modal?
Jordan Park: A/B test Friendly explicit vs Minimal. Smoke tests checkbox OK but default off. Also add a small tertiary note link 'How dry runs work' that opens docs.
Samir Patel: UI note: if the user has pending edits in the release plan, show a subtle warning line: 'Unsaved changes will be included in the simulation.'
Olga Kuznetsova: For SR users, the CTA aria-label should include the non-destructive note: 'Run simulation, does not modify production traffic'. Rohit please wire `modal.cta.primary.aria` separately.
Rohit Desai: I'll add i18n keys: deploy.dryrun.title.friendly, deploy.dryrun.body.friendly, deploy.dryrun.cta.primary etc. Also add telemetry event DRYRUN_STARTED and include is_non_destructive flag.
Nina Park: Thanks everyone  I'll add strings to the PR and tag docs + infra for smoke test integration. Landing copy today unless objections.
